## Checklist

- [ ] `make check` passes locally.
- [ ] Each changed skill has a bumped `metadata.version` and a matching `CHANGELOG.md` section.
- [ ] The skill's `README.md` (user guide) still describes how it behaves.
- [ ] Financial content: every formula, threshold and default is consistent with a cited reference; no market data or company facts are hard-coded as "known" values.
- [ ] Section numbers, table IDs and cross-references still resolve.
- [ ] The skill was tried on at least one real request (describe it below).
